root_cause.text: `seg6_input_core()` and `rpl_input()` attempt to cache a non-refcounted (NOREF) destination cache (`dst`) entry returned by `ip6_route_input()` without first forcing a reference count on it, allowing a concurrent task to release and free the underlying `pcpu_rt` entry before `dst_hold()` is called during caching.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `skb_dst_force(skb)` immediately after `ip6_route_input(skb)` in both `rpl_input()` and `seg6_input_core()` to force a reference count on the NOREF `dst` before it is cached, preventing a use-after-free when `dst_hold()` is subsequently invoked.
